title: Consolidate Monorepo Into Single Files
description: Consolidate monorepo source into single files where frameworks allow. Keep required separate entry points (Vite main.ts, package.json subpath exports for puzzle plays, vitest/playwright configs). Merge playground core index+core, renderer boot into index, fold lint.script.ts into script.ts where present. Update imports and package exports. Run tests.
summary: Consolidated @framework/playground into single source files where bundlers allow: merged index.ts into core.ts (package export `.` → core.ts only), merged shell.tsx and boot-playground.ts into renderer/react/index.tsx (./shell and ./boot aliases point at index.tsx), removed deleted files, updated vitest/vite aliases and playground core vitest include. Kept separate: puzzle play host subpaths (board/scene/topology), Vite main.ts per play, vitest/playwright/vite configs. Verified @framework/playground core (4 tests) and renderer react (4 tests) via bun ./script.ts test.
